title: Territory Manifest
description: A region's own declaration of what it is accountable for and who watches it. The region OWNS this file and edits it in its own tree — the network only indexes it. Validated against a declared JSON-Schema keyword subset (see capabilities --json), not full 2020-12.

schema_version.description: Additive-only within a major. A deprecation is announced one minor ahead.

region.description: The region's slug. Matches the repo/building name.

maintainers.description: Who answers for this region. Surfaced in atlas CONFLICT blocks so cross-region overlaps reach a human.

outcomes.description: What 'healthy' means here. Outcomes are the contract a stationed construct is accountable to — not tasks, not features.

scopes.description: Territory bounds — the blast radius. POSIX globs, repo-root-relative, case-sensitive, ** recursive, no symlink traversal. Overlapping scopes WITHIN a region are a validator error; overlaps ACROSS regions surface as an atlas CONFLICT (wardens never fight silently).

loadout.description: The constructs stationed over this region's outcomes. The maintainer composes this — the network never prescribes it.

outcomes.description: Which of this region's outcomes this construct answers for. Must resolve against outcomes[].

scopes.description: Optional narrowing — a subset of the region's scopes. Omitted means the whole region.

authority_tier.description: A CEILING, not a grant. The maximum this region will EVER allow this construct. The EARNED tier lives in the L4 graduated-trust ledger and can never exceed this. Default and birth tier: observe.

trust.description: The predicates that bound L4 tier transitions for this region. The maintainer owns these numbers.
